title: Idea Tournament
description: IDEATE-stage artifact. Output of idea-tournament-ranker. A complete round-robin pairwise tournament over a set of research ideas: every distinct pair plays exactly once (C(N,2) matchups), winner determined by score_key with stable tiebreak by idea_id. The ranking is by win-count DESC then idea_id (contiguous 1..N). NEVER a score mean — this is a real pairwise bracket. evidence_ref binds to the hypothesis_set or source the ideas came from (anti-slop). No selected/chosen/picked/winner-idea field: the director picks via the /idea-bet gate.

matchups.description: Every distinct pair plays once. C(N,2) matchups for N ideas. Each matchup records pair_a, pair_b, and winner (which must equal pair_a or pair_b — enforced by tournament_bracket.py and a test).

winner.description: idea_id of the winner — MUST equal pair_a or pair_b. Enforced by tournament_bracket.py.

ranking.description: All N ideas ranked by win-count DESC, then idea_id ASC as stable tiebreak. rank is contiguous 1..N.

rank.description: Rank in the tournament, 1 = most wins. Assigned 1..N contiguously.

wins.description: Number of matchups won by this idea. Maximum N-1 (wins all).

evidence_ref.description: Anti-slop: references to the hypothesis_set artifact or source(s) the ideas were drawn from. At least one required; each must be non-blank.
